identity: A biology multiple-choice question bank (cells, hormones, biomolecules, anatomy). Twenty items, each occupying exactly one <NL>-delimited line as [stem][option][option][option][option]. Register = §S, pure layout segmentation; no running prose anywhere in the document.
law: Layout, not syntax. Each line is one item: the stem is ONE segment however long, and each answer option is ONE segment however long. The connectives inside an option never cut (S2) - و inside يزداد افراز Adh و يقل الالدوستيرون stays welded, and وهو سكر متعدد stays inside its option. A multi-word catch-all is a single option: أول إجابتين, لاشئ مما سبق, كل ما سبق, جميع الإجابات السابقة صحيحة, ترقوه و عجزيه. Numbers never split: الببسين 1 5 is one option (1.5 is a decimal, A2).
reasoning: The only real decisions are where each stem ends, and the batch-12 rule from doc_87ac286b6785 (يصنع الصابون من زيت / الزيتون / دوار الشمس / السمسم) settles them: a head word that appears ONCE and is shared by all options belongs to the stem, because options must be parallel to each other. @7 الخلايا: it occurs once and options 2 and 3 are bare adjective pairs (البرنشيميه والكولنشيميه), so الخلايا is the shared head and goes to the stem, leaving three parallel pairs - med, this is the call I am least sure of. @39 العالم and @82 النيتروجين: same test; النيتروجين is also the grammatical subject of يدخل, so it cannot be an option. @278 ب is the CONTRAST case and it is what stopped me over-applying the rule: الحمض appears FOUR times (@279 @282 @285 @288), once inside each option, so it is not a factored prefix and the stem stops at the preposition ب - the same reasoning keeps خلايا inside the options of item 15, where the fourth option أنيبيبات منوية lacks it. @106 ب likewise: the options share no prefix (زيادة, زيادة, قلة), so the stem ends at the preposition. Item 11 has four long paired options; each has the shape [substance] يتكون من [structure] [function], which fixes the cuts at @137 @150 @160 @174 - the internal يتكون verbs are inside options and do not cut, and وعضالتها/والمرونة are و + noun (protected). Every token before a <NL> and the final token are taken as free boundaries; all 19 of them are present.
